{"lean_source": "import Std

namespace BucketAgg

inductive FillMode where
  | none
  | previous

def valid (start end width : Nat) : Prop :=
  start ≤ end ∧ width > 0

def solve (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat)) : List (String × Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
  let groups : List String :=
    (events.map (fun e => e.1)).fold (fun acc g => if acc.contains g then acc else acc ++ [g]) []
  let sortedGroups : List String :=
    List.sort (List.eraseDups groups)
  let bucketStarts : List Nat :=
    let rec gen (s : Nat) : List Nat :=
      if s < end then [s] ++ gen (s + width) else []
    gen start
  let bucketResults : List (String × Nat × Nat × Option Nat) :=
    List.flatMap (fun g =>
      List.map (fun bs =>
        let inBucket : List (Option Nat) :=
          events.filter (fun e => e.1 = g ∧ e.2.1 >= bs ∧ e.2.1 < min (bs + width) end).map (fun e => e.2.2)
        let nonNulls : List Nat :=
          inBucket.filter (fun v => v.isSome).map (fun v => v.get!)
        let cnt : Nat := nonNulls.length
        let sum : Nat := nonNulls.sum
        let val : Option Nat :=
          if cnt > 0 then some sum
          else if fill = FillMode.none then none
          else
            let prevBuckets : List (Nat × Option Nat) :=
              List.map (fun bs' =>
                let inB : List (Option Nat) :=
                  events.filter (fun e => e.1 = g ∧ e.2.1 >= bs' ∧ e.2.1 < min (bs' + width) end).map (fun e => e.2.2)
                let nn : List Nat := inB.filter (fun v => v.isSome).map (fun v => v.get!)
                let c : Nat := nn.length
                let s : Nat := nn.sum
                (bs', if c > 0 then some s else none)
              ) (List.takeWhile (fun b => b < bs) bucketStarts)
            let lastNonEmpty : Option (Option Nat) :=
              List.filterMap (fun p => if p.2.isSome then some p.2 else none) prevBuckets |>.getLast
            lastNonEmpty
        (g, bs, cnt, val)
      ) bucketStarts
    ) sortedGroups
  bucketResults

theorem thm_O1 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  let outGroups : List String := out.map (fun r => r.1)
  let inGroups : List String := (events.map (fun e => e.1)).fold (fun acc g => if acc.contains g then acc else acc ++ [g]) []
  let sortedInGroups : List String := List.sort (List.eraseDups inGroups)
  List.sort (List.eraseDups outGroups) = sortedInGroups := by sorry

theorem thm_O2 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  let rec gen (s : Nat) : List Nat :=
    if s < end then [s] ++ gen (s + width) else []
  let expectedStarts : List Nat := gen start
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g).map (fun r => r.2.1)) = expectedStarts := by sorry

theorem thm_O3 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, ∀ t : Nat,
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs).length = 1) →
    (t >= bs ∧ t < min (bs + width) end) ↔
    (∃ v : Option Nat, events.contains (g, t, v)) := by sorry

theorem thm_O4 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, ∀ cnt : Nat, ∀ val : Option Nat,
    out.contains (g, bs, cnt, val) →
    cnt = (events.filter (fun e => e.1 = g ∧ e.2.1 >= bs ∧ e.2.1 < min (bs + width) end ∧ e.2.2.isSome)).length := by sorry

theorem thm_O5 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, ∀ cnt : Nat, ∀ val : Option Nat,
    out.contains (g, bs, cnt, val) → cnt > 0 →
    val = some ((events.filter (fun e => e.1 = g ∧ e.2.1 >= bs ∧ e.2.1 < min (bs + width) end ∧ e.2.2.isSome)).map (fun e => e.2.2.get!).sum) := by sorry

theorem thm_O6 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  fill = FillMode.none →
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, ∀ cnt : Nat, ∀ val : Option Nat,
    out.contains (g, bs, cnt, val) → cnt = 0 → val = none := by sorry

theorem thm_O7 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  fill = FillMode.previous →
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, ∀ cnt : Nat, ∀ val : Option Nat,
    out.contains (g, bs, cnt, val) → cnt = 0 →
    (∃ prevBs : Nat, prevBs < bs ∧
      (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = prevBs ∧ r.2.2 > 0)).length = 1 ∧
      (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = prevBs)).head!.2.3 = val) ∨
    (∀ prevBs : Nat, prevBs < bs → (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = prevBs ∧ r.2.2 > 0)).length = 0) → val = none := by sorry

theorem thm_O8 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  fill = FillMode.previous →
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs1 bs2 : Nat, bs1 < bs2 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs1 ∧ r.2.2 = 0)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs2 ∧ r.2.2 = 0)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs2)).head!.2.3 = (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs1)).head!.2.3 := by sorry

theorem thm_O9 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  fill = FillMode.previous →
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs : Nat, bs >= start →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs ∧ r.2.2 = 0)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs)).head!.2.3 =
    (List.filterMap (fun p => if p.2.isSome then some p.2 else none)
      (List.map (fun bs' =>
        let inB : List (Option Nat) :=
          events.filter (fun e => e.1 = g ∧ e.2.1 >= bs' ∧ e.2.1 < min (bs' + width) end ∧ e.2.1 >= start).map (fun e => e.2.2)
        let nn : List Nat := inB.filter (fun v => v.isSome).map (fun v => v.get!)
        let c : Nat := nn.length
        let s : Nat := nn.sum
        (bs', if c > 0 then some s else none)
      ) (List.takeWhile (fun b => b < bs) (let rec gen (s : Nat) : List Nat := if s < end then [s] ++ gen (s + width) else [] in gen start))) |>.getLast) := by sorry

theorem thm_O10 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  ∀ i j : Nat, i < out.length → j < out.length → i < j →
    (out[i].1 < out[j].1) ∨ (out[i].1 = out[j].1 ∧ out[i].2.1 < out[j].2.1) := by sorry

theorem thm_O11 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  fill = FillMode.previous →
  ∀ g : String, ∀ bs1 bs2 : Nat, bs1 < bs2 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs1 ∧ r.2.2 > 0 ∧ r.2.3 = some 0)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs2 ∧ r.2.2 = 0)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs2)).head!.2.3 = some 0 := by sorry

theorem thm_O12 (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat))
  (h : valid start end width) :
  let out := solve start end width fill events
  ∀ g : String, ∀ t : Nat, ∀ v : Option Nat, v.isSome →
    (events.filter (fun e => e = (g, t, v))).length > 0 →
    let bs : Nat := start + (t - start) / width * width
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs)).length = 1 →
    (out.filter (fun r => r.1 = g ∧ r.2.1 = bs)).head!.2.2 >= (events.filter (fun e => e = (g, t, v))).length := by sorry

theorem non_vacuity :
  ∃ (start end width : Nat) (fill : FillMode) (events : List (String × Nat × Option Nat)),
    valid start end width ∧
    (solve start end width fill events).length > 0 ∧
    ∃ (start' end' width' : Nat) (fill' : FillMode) (events' : List (String × Nat × Option Nat)),
      valid start' end' width' ∧
      (solve start' end' width' fill' events').length = 0 := by sorry

end BucketAgg",
